reason: I'm not uploading a whole export of my staff group chat to a bot I've never heard of, and I don't want it in my Google Drive either. My real problem is receipts that never get sent at all, and a duplicate checker doesn't fix that.
objection: Giving a bot my work chats and access to my Google account. 'Only encrypted fingerprints' is easy to say, but I can't check it, and after the free part my staff and I would probably go back to doing it the old way.
would_change_my_mind: If my accountant or another shop owner I know had used it for a few months and told me it was safe, and I could try it by forwarding a few receipts privately without connecting my Google account.
